notes.subject: the weeping of rivers
notes.rationale: מבכי read as 'weeping' (damming the rivers' flow like tears) or as מבכה 'springs' — most read springs; the literal picture is kept and listed as a second reading

notes.subject: מבכי
notes.rationale: the same consonants carry both 'weeping' and 'spring', a play on water leaving its place

notes.subject: to
notes.rationale: Hebrew has simply 'light' — the preposition marks the outcome of bringing out

notes.subject: ותעללומה
notes.rationale: the hidden thing (תעלמה) brought out to light — hiddenness made explicit in the mining imagery

translation: The weeping of rivers he bound, and the hidden thing he brings out to light.
